experiment: P1 phase-aware complex masked reconstruction for E
hypothesis: Complex masked reconstruction with a phase-weighted loss preserves inter-sensor phase better than magnitude/reconstruction and untrained E on mp_cal.

method.mask: 80% random 4x4 TF blocks in E output grid; input nearest-upsampled to T=29
method.head: 3xConv2d(C,C,3,dilations 1/2/4)+Conv2d(C,2,1); bilinear to T=29
method.loss: masked MSE(Re/Im) + phase term: (1-cos(angle(rec)-angle(x))) weighted by |x|, mean over masked bins
method.phase_offset: complex Re/Im target retains absolute phase; no IF-only target

data.train: multipath mp_cal, SNR 0/5/10; 512 sources per SNR
data.val: multipath mp_cal, SNR 0/5/10; 128 sources per SNR

evaluation.readout: same per-bin phase readout as P2; fit 8103, eval 8102; 28 pairs

decision_rule.pass: >=20% better than P2 single-path recon and untrained on mp_cal 10 dB for >=2/3 seeds
decision_rule.fail: phase-aware objective not enough; record negative result; P5 by separate decision

checks: GPU preflight; finite loss/grad; feature rank/std
validator PASS; no Markdown in bundle
limits: synthetic multipath; mono E; hybrid_small proxy
phase term uses observed X, not clean D
